_readme: What Pepper says or asks for each topic it hears (15 Nov). Pepper's app only knows the topic names (keywords in water_keywords.top); the text here can be changed on this laptop at any time, without updating Pepper. 'say' = spoken as written (no AI); 'officer' / 'farmer' = the question sent to AquaMaa in that mode. Restart api.py after editing.

hello.say: Hello, I am AquaMaa. Qatar's farm wells are getting saltier, and farmers find out too late; I read the well sensors live and tell you what the water means. Ask me about the salinity, the temperature, the pH, or the alerts.

bye.say: You are welcome. I will keep watching the wells. Goodbye!

report.officer: Give me a briefing on all the wells: their status, the water quality index and the alerts
report.farmer: Give me a report of the wells on my farm and what each can be used for

salinity.officer: What is the average salinity across all the wells right now and what does it mean
salinity.farmer: What is the salinity of my well right now and what does it mean

temperature.officer: What is the water temperature across the wells right now and what does it mean
temperature.farmer: What is the water temperature of my well right now and what does it mean

ph.officer: What is the average pH across the wells right now and what does it mean
ph.farmer: What is the pH of my well water right now and what does it mean

drink.officer: Is the water in the wells suitable for drinking right now
drink.farmer: Is my well water safe to drink right now

irrigation.officer: Is the water in the wells suitable for irrigation of date palms right now
irrigation.farmer: Can I irrigate my date palms with my well water right now

crops.officer: Which crops can be irrigated with the water in the wells right now
crops.farmer: Which crops can I grow with my well water right now

trend.officer: Is salinity rising across the wells

advice.officer: What should the ministry do about the salinity of the wells right now
advice.farmer: What should I do about my well water right now

test.officer: How should well water be tested
test.farmer: How do I test my well water

attention.officer: Which wells need attention right now and why
attention.farmer: Does any of my wells need attention right now

offline.officer: Are any sensors offline right now
offline.farmer: Is my well sensor working right now

index.officer: What is the water quality index of the wells right now
index.farmer: What is the water quality index of my well right now

municipality.officer: Which municipality has the most wells
municipality.farmer: Which municipality has the most wells

law.officer: What is the penalty for digging a well without a licence
law.farmer: Do I need a licence to dig a new well

dashboard.officer: What does the dashboard show right now
dashboard.farmer: What does my farm page show right now
